    • checkSideHit

      public int checkSideHit(Entity platform, com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 raycastEnd)
      Checks the raycast end location of the grapple on the platform and converts it into a usable side int that can be compared against the valid grapple sides for this platform
      Parameters:
      platform - the entity that should be checked against the raycast. Note: should be a known platform!
      raycastEnd - the Vector2 object created by the physics engine's raycast that corresponds to the final point in the world the grapple hit
      Returns:
      a base 10 integer representing which side of the platform was hit by the player's grapple. Can only be 1 (BOTTOM_SIDE), 2 (RIGHT_SIDE), 4 (TOP_SIDE) or 8 (LEFT_SIDE).

    • calculatePlatformBounds

      protected com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2[] calculatePlatformBounds(Entity platform)
      Uses an entity's get center and position methods to determine the bounding box for the entity, assuming it's a square/rectangle. Note: this function does not check if the provided Entity is a valid platform or not. If this is a concern, please ensure the calling method does this check
      Parameters:
      platform - the platform to determine the bounding box coordinates for
      Returns:
      an array with 2 Vector2 elements: the top left coordinates and the bottom right coordinates that represent the outer bounds of this platform

    • successfulGrapple

      public boolean successfulGrapple(int hitSide)
      Tests whether the side of the platform hit with the player's grapple is a valid grapple side for this platform.
      Parameters:
      hitSide - the base 10 integer representing which side of the platform was hit by the player's grapple. Can only be 1, 2, 4, or 8
      Returns:
      true if the grapple was successful, or false if grapple was unsuccessful or an invalid hitSide integer was provided
